name: modbusDiscovery
label: Modbus Discovery
prerequisite:
A mock ouput is available into the playbooks for DEMO purpose.
Edit the Playbooks Configuration step to modify the "useMockOutput" to True if needed.
description:
This Solution Pack provides Playbooks related to Modbus assets.
It performs a network scan to discover the Modbus assets connected or attached behind a Modbus gateway and create them in Asset module.
It raises an Alert when new Assets are discovered.
It enrich your Modbus Asset based on the Modbus function : Read Device Information
